weeks.rationale: Recovery bridge after the official 13 September 10 km race. It keeps daily movement and upper-body work while reducing running to 54 km, all easy, so the following base weeks begin from absorbed work rather than residual race fatigue.
weeks.methodology: The race replaces the planned field test. Easy running carries the week; no threshold, hard simulation, lower-body lifting, or plyometrics are added. Sunday is active recovery rather than a full rest day, but it must create no meaningful fatigue.
